title: Concept: XPath built by concatenation (python) — review required
description: In python, tree.xpath("//user[@id='" + i + "']") embeds values in XPath text. Quote and axis syntax in input escapes the intended predicate. The remedy is variable binding via xpath variables.
applicability: python codebases querying XML with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: XML disclosure and authentication bypass on XPath-based checks; HIGH severity.
